name: python-practice
description: Practice exercises for the python learning plan. Its checks may be seen and retried; the final set (python-final) is separate.

tasks.name: clamp
tasks.title: Add clamp(x, lo, hi) to numbers_util.py
tasks.description: clamp(5, 0, 3) == 3, clamp(-1, 0, 3) == 0, clamp(2, 0, 3) == 2. Add tests in tests/test_numbers_util.py.
checks: python3 -c "from numbers_util import clamp as c; assert (c(5, 0, 3), c(-1, 0, 3), c(2, 0, 3)) == (3, 0, 2)"

tasks.name: word-count
tasks.title: Add word_count(text) to words.py
tasks.description: word_count returns a dict of lower-cased words to their counts; punctuation is not part of a word. word_count('A a, b!') == {'a': 2, 'b': 1}.
checks: python3 -c "from words import word_count as w; assert w('A a, b!') == {'a': 2, 'b': 1} and w('') == {}"
